event_summary: A black kettlebell descends onto a sideways white cup on a wooden tabletop and the cup becomes flattened beneath it.
raw_event_description: At the start, a white disposable cup lies on its side on a wooden tabletop, with a black object partially visible near the top of the frame. The black object moves downward and becomes identifiable as a kettlebell with a curved handle and blue “30 LB” marking. The kettlebell approaches the cup, makes visible contact with the cup, and the cup visibly changes from a rounded sideways shape into a flattened white shape under the kettlebell. The kettlebell then remains positioned over the flattened cup.

reasons: The white cup is clearly visible on the tabletop.
Only the lower portion of the black descending object is visible at the top edge.
The contact event has not yet occurred.
